requiredFindings.title: The since-r102 commit list includes 20 commits outside its declared range
requiredFindings.detail: productChangesSinceR102 declares a50ae9646c9cf6b6c3600c2c28c816f7a77ab609 through 9501ec9d167200e82580fbeab73afd2d1cbd7159, but commits contains 27 entries. Git rev-list --reverse a50ae96..9501ec9 returns seven. The first 20 entries, beginning 2b297e68 and ending at the excluded lower endpoint a50ae964, belong to the preceding history. The final seven entries are correct. This makes the new machine-readable change history inaccurate even though its 14-file list is correct.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Replace this commits array with the exact seven commits in the declared range, preserving the separately named older history, and refresh affected subject pins.

requiredFindings.title: The configuration/discovery scope list repeats E260–E285
requiredFindings.detail: The first 80 configurationDiscoveryScopes entries exactly equal r102. The next 26 entries are exact duplicate copies of the inherited E260–E285 rows, followed by E286–E293. The result is 114 entries instead of the inherited 80 plus eight new scopes (88). The accepted-work ledger itself correctly contains 293 unique continuation records; this finding concerns the separate source scope projection.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Remove only the newly duplicated E260–E285 block, retain the inherited 80 entries by value and append E286–E293 once, then refresh affected subject pins.
